name: Ralf Seekatz - § 32 - Am 8
title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2024
part_text: 32. Highlights the importance of preserving shareholders’ and creditors’ primary responsibility for bearing losses in the event of a bank’s failure; stresses that resorting to using taxpayers’ money, directly or indirectly, is to be precluded, which is still a key lesson learned from the global financial crisis; stresses that the bail-in of shareholders and creditors must remain the main source for resolution financing before any recourse is made to industry-funded sources;
